//_sidecar: NOT run in this headless environment. This file is config data consumed by the `cargo tauri` CLI on a machine with a display + webview libs; it is not executed by `cargo check`. The actual native shell logic (spawn/pipe/restart the Node sidecar) lives in src-tauri/src/main.rs, a plain std-only Rust binary you can `cargo run` directly. The Tauri build step wraps that behavior as this app's `beforeDevCommand`/`beforeBuildCommand`, or as an externalBin sidecar, depending on how the real build wires it up — that wiring was not attempted here.
